newsitem.title: UK: Utd News shares up,analysts raise estimates.
newsitem.headline: Utd News shares up,analysts raise estimates.

text.p: Shares in United News & Media Plc rose 11 pence to 740-1/2, after the group reported 1996 results which beat most market expectations and prompted several analysts to raise their 1997 profit forecasts.
"I would have thought most would be upgrading," said one industry watcher, who raised his estimate to 335 million stg from just below 330 million.

Another said he had not yet decided by how much he would raise his forecast after United News & Media earlier reported a 12 percent rise in 1996 pre-tax profit before exceptional items to 290.2 million stg.
"Overall a pretty impressive performance and I expect more of the same in 1997," this industry watcher said.
